text:
Hannah Cho: quick thread 1: small UX/A11y review for the rollout timeline. main items: wording parity for rollforward vs rollback, concise SR announces for scrubber, and compact variant labels for PMs. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/example/roll-ui
Devon Park: main suggestion: keep menu verbs short: 'Rollback' and 'Roll forward'. in confirmation modals use explicit language: title 'Confirm roll forward' / 'Confirm rollback', body 'This will make vX.Y live for all traffic. Audit note (optional):', primary 'Roll forward'/'Revert' accordingly.
Sofia Ruiz: label nit: show short friendly labels like 'Canary A' on pills and full model slug in tooltip/flyout. tooltip must be keyboard-expandable (Enter) not hover-only. add visible letter prefix (A/B) to help colorblind users.
A11yBot: SR guidance: use aria-live='polite' with minimal phrases. examples: 'History: Jun 03, 2026  staged 10% to Canary A (canary)'; 'History: Jun 02, 2026  reverted to v2.5 (reverted)'. when allocation changes emit 'Allocation changed: Canary A +5%'. set aria-atomic=true.
Hannah Cho: undo: show ephemeral banner 'Rolled forward to v3.0  Undo' with 25s timer. banner uses role='status' for SR announcement, but do NOT steal focus unless user triggered via keyboard shortcut. Undo must be keyboard-focusable.
Devon Park: percent slider backend only accepts whole integers. UI should enforce integer steps and show helper text: 'Traffic allocation accepts whole percentages only.' also prevent decimal input.
Sofia Ruiz: microinteraction: when focusing a checkpoint, Enter opens context menu, arrow keys navigate menu, Esc closes. focus returns to checkpoint after modal closes.
Hannah Cho: telemetry + compliance: save optional audit note with history entry and make filterable/exportable. ops: will ensure CSV includes notes.
PreviewBot: preview deployed for branch 'rollwording-a11y' at sha aa11bb  https://preview.redwood.dev/rollwording-a11y
Devon Park: thanks — will test Safari keyboard flow later. tagging @Sofia for final copy sign-off.
